name: SELENE

variants.power: She carries her night journey across the sky as the moon goddess; the moon itself is a clear physical silver lunar disc behind her, moonlight illuminates the robe and white horses. No emitted magic beams or energy trail. [selene-c01, selene-c02]
variants.setting: The vast dark night sky on her documented celestial journey. [selene-c02]
variants.camera: Tight frontal extreme low-angle chariot composition; Selene's crescent crown, face and upper body fill central upper two-thirds, two horse heads clearly separate along lower corners, no distant tiny goddess.
variants.light: One dominant silver moon backlight, deep midnight-brown sky, dramatic silver rim light and tactile robe folds.
